label: water-quality-workflow
info: Stage 1-4: Receive water-quality MQTT telemetry, validate and normalize messages, insert accepted readings into Railway TimescaleDB, evaluate each inserted reading against configured thresholds, then create de-duplicated decision events and proposed operator actions (simulation only).

name: Water Quality — MQTT validation + DB insertion + thresholds + decision events
info: Reuses existing b_hre MQTT broker configuration. Topic: hre/water-quality-telemetry/harare/#. Accepted readings are inserted into water_quality_telemetry using a dedicated PostgreSQL pool. Each inserted reading is then evaluated by WQ_THRESHOLD_ENGINE against water_quality_limits (msg.threshold). Rejected packets go to a separate Debug output. No physical actions occur. WQ_DECISION_EVENT creates decision_event and action_log rows for warning/critical readings (suppressing duplicates while an open/acknowledged event exists). Simulation only.
